cohort: 62 neonates with hyperammonemia admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of the Children's Hospital of Fudan University between April 2013 and June 2020
finding: Longer length of stay and MS administration were significant protective factors for short-term survival, while invasive mechanical ventilation, DELTA<0, coma, and electrolyte disturbance increased the risk of death.
